coverage.non_warrant_content: P001 sets the account-creation-to-first-publication process boundary. Candidate names in P002 identify the competing set rather than separate findings that each mechanism occurs. The remaining state content is represented by the claims.

Routine implementation details include inspecting invitations, draft saves and publication first (P006); asking about intended timing, available information, offline preparation and stopping points (P007); maintaining an explanation-by-evidence table after each batch (P009); and specifying eligibility, assignment and the primary measure before launch (P014). These instructions do not independently assert that a mechanism exists or an intervention works. P013 also supplies contextual identification of the comparison in C032.

P020 qualifies the proposed diagnostic observations and is included substantively in their cited bundles. P022 additionally instructs monitoring guardrails and intermediate behavior and collecting brief explanations from a sample of continuing non-publishers; these are data-collection tasks without an additional asserted result.

The substantive inference content is represented in the claims. References to the selected change, predefined endpoint and next inquiry organize the decision procedure without supplying additional findings. C044 and C045 make explicit the conditional reading of 'otherwise' in P029.

All substantive limitations and proposed bias-control rationales are represented. Shared introductory wording and list structure in P030–P037 organize these propositions without adding independent claims.

anomalies.detail: P010 conditions using the release slot for a narrowly scoped change on identifying an actionable obstacle, while P012 prescribes a diagnostic prompt or event improvement when explanations remain undistinguished. The mapping does not explicitly delimit whether the term 'change' in P010 includes those diagnostic options. Both branches remain preserved without resolving that scope.
